_help.tiers.small.grow: Small juice: how far a piece swells past full size (0.07 = 7%). Used by the moments set to "small".
_help.tiers.small.shake: Small juice: how far a "no" shake moves sideways, as a share of the piece's width. (Only the "no" shake uses shake.)
_help.tiers.medium.grow: Medium juice: how far a piece swells past full size (0.3 = 30%).
_help.tiers.medium.shake: Medium juice: how far a "no" shake moves sideways, as a share of the piece's width — only matters if the "no" shake is set to medium.
_help.tiers.big.grow: Big juice: how far a piece swells past full size (0.5 = 50%).
_help.tiers.big.shake: Big juice: how far a "no" shake moves sideways — only matters if the "no" shake is set to big.
_help.events.seedPop: Which juice size each seed's "+1" pops with: small, medium or big (Juice sizes). Text — edit it in the file.
_help.events.totalPop: Which juice size the turn's total ("+6") pops with: small, medium or big.
_help.events.turnPulse: Which juice size your glyphlings breathe with at the start of your turn: small, medium or big.
_help.events.noShake: Which juice size the "no" shake uses (tapping something you can't move): small, medium or big.
_help.events.refreshGrow: Which juice size a new seed swells with as it grows into the tray after a Refresh: small, medium or big.
